articles.headline: Cyclone lashes New Zealand's North Island, hundreds evacuated
articles.description: Conditions will ease as Cyclone Vaianu works its way down the North Island before exiting on Sunday evening at Hawke's Bay, New Zealand's MetService said.

articles.headline: Cyclone Vaianu: Ōhope couple flee home as winds batter Bay of Plenty
articles.description: Kylee Kast had to evacuate as Cyclone Vaianu's winds suddenly intensified.

articles.headline: Category 3 cyclone pummels New Zealand
articles.description: A category 3 tropical cyclone pummelled New Zealand's North Island on Sunday, triggering flooding and damaging infrastructure but authorities were relieved it bypassed Auckland, the country's most populous city. The storm was expected to cross the eastern Nor…

articles.headline: 32-Foot Cyclone Swell Pummels New Zealand as Thousands Flee (Video)
articles.description: Tropical Cyclone Vaianu hit New Zealand over the weekend, sending large and stormy surf to the nation, along with evacuation warnings due to flooding.
